Multivariate dispersion (PERMDISP) with optional group tests

Source: R/mp_stats.R
mp_dispersion.Rd

Runs vegan::betadisper() to test homogeneity of multivariate dispersions (PERMDISP) – the standard companion to PERMANOVA – and plots each sample's distance to its group centroid. Additional group-difference statistics (ANOSIM, MRPP, PERMANOVA) can be appended to the caption.

Usage

mp_dispersion(
  object,
  group.by = NULL,
  distance = "bray",
  add.test = NULL,
  permutations = 999,
  plot.type = c("box", "violin"),
  point.size = 1.5,
  palette = NULL,
  theme = NULL,
  ...,
  plot.title = NULL,
  plot.subtitle = NULL,
  plot.caption = NULL,
  font.size = getOption("micropubr.font.size", 11),
  interactive = FALSE,
  return.data = FALSE,
  verbose = getOption("micropubr.verbose", FALSE)
)

Arguments

object

A phyloseq::phyloseq object.

group.by

Sample-metadata column defining the groups.

distance

Distance metric (see mp_ordination(); default "bray").

add.test

Optional character vector of further tests to summarise in the caption: any of "anosim", "mrpp", "permanova".

permutations

Number of permutations.

plot.type

One of "box" or "violin".

point.size

Size of jittered sample points.

palette, theme, plot.title, plot.subtitle, plot.caption, font.size

See mp_alpha().

...

Passed to the primary geom.

interactive

If TRUE, return an interactive plotly widget instead of a static ggplot (requires plotly). See mp_alpha().

return.data

If TRUE, return the per-sample distance-to-centroid data frame (with the betadisper object attached) instead of a plot.

verbose

Print the methods used.

Value

A ggplot object, a plotly widget when interactive = TRUE, or a data frame when return.data = TRUE.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data(GlobalPatterns, package = "phyloseq")
mp_dispersion(GlobalPatterns, group.by = "SampleType",
              add.test = "permanova")
} # }
